drag knobs & faders · click WAVE / FOOTAGE / LFO / TEMPER selectors to cycle · shift-click controls in one row to lock them — dragging any of them moves the group · ⚄ rolls a row (locked controls roll together) · ⇗ fans a ramp across clones 1→16 · RANDOM rerolls everything from a new seed. NOTE 1·2·3 per strip picks which held MIDI note the clone follows; ENV knobs travel fast/fast → fast/slow → slow/slow.
